Topic at a Glance
Article 276 of the Constitution of India is titled “Taxes on professions, trades, callings and employments”. It forms an integral component of Finance, Property, Contracts and Suits (Articles 264–300A), located within the “Finance” cluster. Current through the 106th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2023.

Constitutional Text & Anatomy
